title: Anti Far Creeper
description: prevents the creeper from being placed at a range where it cannot be hit
body:
# This mod will help you in creeper PvP.
If you've ever encountered a situation where you place a creeper and can't hit it, this mod is the perfect solution! It won't let you place a creeper at a distance beyond your reach. And by pressing the U key, you can turn it on and off.
